exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: gpa.class_attendance_rule: Location dwell at least 90% of scheduled class period

inputBoundary: One already-derived finite dwell percentage for one student at the scheduled class location during the scheduled class period.
outputBoundary: Classify the class period as not attended below 90% location dwell and attended at or above 90%; equality is attended.
limitations: This binding does not identify a student's classes from transcripts or join registrar schedule and location data.
This binding does not determine whether location observations belong to the scheduled class location.
This binding does not reconstruct dwell intervals or derive the scheduled-period dwell numerator or denominator.
This binding does not aggregate per-class classifications into student attendance rates.
A missing class-period dwell percentage fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
